dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - Usage - Data Ingest and Free Tier
dashboard.description: Monthly and 24 hour dashboard for New Relic ingest usage, projected run rate, noisy sources, and free-tier safety actions. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Ingest usage
pages.description: Free-tier budget and noisy source triage.

widgets.title: Current month ingest by usage metric

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(Gigabytes) FROM NrMTDConsumption FACET usageMetric LIMIT 20 SINCE this month
SELECT sum(Gigabytes) FROM NrConsumption FACET usageMetric TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

widgets.title: Projected monthly ingest at 24h run rate

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT rate(sum(Gigabytes), 1 day) * 31 FROM NrConsumption SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(Gigabytes) / 100 * 100 FROM NrMTDConsumption SINCE this month
SELECT bytecountestimate() FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET unit, level LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(Gigabytes) FROM NrConsumption FACET productLine, usageMetric LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: If projected monthly ingest approaches 100 GB, first reduce debug success logs, successful health checks, oversized lines, and high-cardinality facets before reducing warning or error telemetry.
